answer: Use mutual-stake bonds that bloom like a lotus: each agent locks earned POA before transacting, and every deal needs a counterparty co-signature putting both bonds at risk. A lone relic identity with no co-sign history cannot move value, while a pearl of honest trade builds over time. Sybil factories must fund thousands of bonds with real earned work, and graph analysis spots their dense co-sign clusters and slashes everything at once, so fakes pay full price per identity and lose it all together.
